Players Committee card image of [[There Are Many Hunting You Now]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Once during your turn, may stack top card of Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) on an opponent's character with your Inquisitor. Opponent must choose to lose 1 Force or that character's game text is canceled for remainder of turn. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/There%20Are%20Many%20Hunting%20You%20Now.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/There Are Many Hunting You Now.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
